sentences.text:
Prayer in the present petition is for issuance of direction to the official respondents for invoking Sections 376, 354-C and 509 IPC in FIR No.129 dated 02.10.2024, registered under Sections 66E, 67 and 67A of the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008 at Police Station Urban Estate,
District Patiala.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has specifically raised the contention before this Court on the basis of observation made by learned JMIC, Patiala in para No.4 of the order dated 06.09.2025, wherein it has been mentioned that offences under Sections 292 and 503 IPC are made out.
He submits that there was no evidence collected by the Investigating Agency so far and thus, learned trial Court could not come to the conclusion regarding the said offences.
4. Ms. Ramta Chowdhary, DAG, Punjab, accepts notice on behalf of the State.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

On reading of the order dated 06.09.2025, it is deciphered that learned trial Court had directed the Investigating Agency to conduct a free and fair 1 of 2 CRM-M-66182-2025 investigation regarding adding of offences under Section 376, 354-C and 509 IPC.

The observations made are to the effect that investigation is pending and it is on the conclusion of the investigation, the Investigating Agency would conclude whether these offences are made out or not.

Hence, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to the Investigating Agency to conduct a free and fair investigation and on the conclusion of the same, decide whether prima facie the said offences are made out or not.
6. No further order is required to be passed as learned JMIC has already passed the order dated 06.09.2025.
